column1: Candidate treatment group — DiD Data Collection Workbook

The Deal_Master_Wide sheet has one row per deal, as requested. Enter annual financial and patent data in the t−3 to t+3 columns. The Panel_DiD sheet automatically reshapes the wide data into one row per deal-year for R/Stata estimation.

The source workbooks are candidate screening lists, not final mutually exclusive treatment/control groups. This workbook contains 39 deals whose normalized headline also appears in the other source file. Use the Final_Classification and Main_DiD_Decision fields only after deal-level validation.
